author: IGN
description:
There are six Great Fairy Fountains hidden throughout _The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake_, and finding them will reward you with powerful upgrades and abilities, including Din's Fire, Farore's Wind, Nayru's Love, Double Magic, and Double Defense. This guide shows you where to find every Great Fairy Fountain, how to access each hidden entrance, and what rewards you'll receive for visiting them.

We'll take you through all six locations, including Death Mountain Trail, Hyrule Castle, Zora Fountain, Death Mountain Crater, the Evil Desert Colossus, and Ganondorf's Castle. Whether you're looking to unlock every Great Fairy ability or simply want to track down the remaining fountains, this walkthrough has everything you need.

For more guides, walkthroughs, and tips, check out IGN's _The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake_ Strategy Guide!

author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Rockstar has revealed more of the technical details of GTA 6 on consoles. The game will be aiming for 30 frames per second on Xbox Series X|S, PS5, and PS5 Pro. The PS5 Pro will get more advanced ray-tracing features. However, this comes to the disappointment of some gamers who were hoping for 60fps or at least a performance mode aiming for 40fps on PS5 Pro. But that still hasn't stopped the wave of excitement for what is looking to be the biggest gaming launch of all time: GTA 6 is now the most preloaded game in PlayStation and Xbox history. Sony and Microsoft are urging fans to preload the game before its launch on November 19th, as network services will likely be bottlenecked by the sheer demand for this game. And finally, The Hollywood Reporter has revealed a few details surrounding James Gunn and Peter Safran's ousting at DC Studios.

#IGN #Gaming #GTA6
title: Rockstar Confirms GTA 6 Will Run at 30fps On All Consoles - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description: I've played about five hours of the blue-collar bug-squasher so far, and admittedly it’s grown on me. The special launcher weapons and diverse array of weird-ass bugs keeps skirmishes interesting, and I'm still in the process of finding new jobs to do and new biomes to do them on, so the sense of discovery is still there. But I don't think Exterminauts has made an airtight case for horde shooter fans to choose it over their current favorite. It doesn't have the open-endedness of a Deep Rock Galactic, the slam-dunk tone and mood of Darktide, or the strong satirical comedy of Helldivers II. None of that is a death sentence, especially not this early in development. But it has its dirty work cut out for it.
title: Exterminauts Turns You and 2 Friends Into Intergalactic Pest Control Techs With Some Spicy Weapons

author: IGN
description:
The Shooting Gallery is one of the many minigames you'll encounter in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, offering valuable rewards like bigger Deku Seed Bags and Quivers, along with an easy way to earn extra Rupees. There are two locations to visit: one in Castle Town as a child and another in Kakariko Village as an adult. Both feature Basic and Expert difficulties, with increasingly challenging targets to hit.
 
In this guide, we'll show you how to win both Shooting Gallery minigames, explain the target patterns, and share helpful tips for improving your aim. We'll also explain why Gyro Controls can make a huge difference, how the randomized targets work in Kakariko Village, and how to earn all the available rewards. With these tips, you'll be hitting every target in no time!
title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake: How to Beat BOTH Shooting Galleries
